boundaryMatrix.submitted target: Only begin submitted target uses legacy form normalization; the result must also satisfy strict canonical syntax before grant.
boundaryMatrix.trusted current: Strict casefold-only canonical decoder; invalid state blocks begin and verify before transport.
boundaryMatrix.trusted pending and verification target: Pending is always strict if present, active pending must exist; verify requires strict target equal to strict stored pending, and uses that stored value for target proof. Current selector uses strict stored current. Both malformed branches return invalid before transport.
boundaryMatrix.privileged exclusions: Every trusted value uses strict casefold-only canonical decoder; any malformed exclusion blocks begin and verify.
boundaryMatrix.grant and bearer user: Grant checks envelope/bearer/user id, GET checks error envelope, exact UUID/confirmed identity and strict canonical evidence before PUT.
boundaryMatrix.PUT: Exact email-only body; strict provider new_email and no error envelope required for pending; ambiguity is unknown/no retry.
boundaryMatrix.OTP partial/final: Exact partial two-field envelope only; final requires expected UUID and strictly matching confirmed owned target identity with no error markers; final_candidate still needs canonical reread.

limitations: Provider semantics and configuration remain unattested.
Mock-only, no application wiring or activation.
